description: Course-owned Content Studio: brief, audience, tone, prompt, generated drafts and save. The lab state is server owned; the UI renders it and every change goes through a typed tool.
network_policy: No outbound network from the lab itself. Only the server-side model adapter calls the configured model provider.
credentials_policy: The lab holds no credentials. Provider keys stay in server environment variables.
reset_procedure: Reload the active fixture and clear audience, tone, prompt and drafts. Saved artifacts are kept.
